summary: Full-stack validation of two features: (1) Live admin image upload to Supabase Storage (end-to-end, real PNG bytes, public URL reachable, resource attach persisted); (2) Dynamic rendering of Accueil sections from /api/home-sections (order + enabled + custom title/subtitle). Backend: 15/15 new tests pass. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): all critical flows pass, including dynamic hide/restore of the 'roster' section via CMS toggle. No deprecated Expo packages found. Minor RN warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (framework-level, not user code).

minor.issue: Pre-existing regression test bug in backend_test.py (uses 'id' field but API returns 'episode_id'/'event_id'). API itself works correctly. Not part of this iteration.

Pre-existing regression tests in backend_test.py use wrong payload shape (send flat product_id instead of nested items[].product_id being non-null). Endpoints work; test needs update. Not part of this iteration.

action_items: OPTIONAL: fix pre-existing regression tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py to use correct id fields (episode_id/event_id/product_id) — not part of this iteration but worth cleaning up.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1329 lines — consider splitting into modules (admin_routes, storage_routes, home_sections_routes) for maintainability.

POST /api/admin/home-sections upserts by section_key but does not enforce unique 'order' values — two sections could share the same order (currently OK because sort is stable, but worth noting for CMS UX).

In admin_upload_image, when resource_type is provided but resource_id doesn't match, the file is already uploaded to Storage before the 404 is raised — leaves an orphan blob in Supabase. Consider validating resource existence BEFORE uploading.
seed_data_creation: Test uploaded 2 tiny 1x1 PNG files to Supabase buckets 'accueil' and 'roster' (linked to wr_marek.photo). Also toggled 'promotions' section enable/disable during CMS CRUD test. Frontend UI test toggled 'roster' OFF then back ON; final state restored — public /home-sections returns the 6 default sections in order 0..5, promotions disabled.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live upload to Supabase Storage is confirmed working via multipart POST to /api/admin/upload. Public URLs (https://wctcmpyjuwnvoandyqei.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/<bucket>/<path>) are reachable. Home sections CMS is fully functional; frontend renders dynamically and reacts to enabled/order changes. The 7 section_keys are: banniere, prochain_show, dernieres_nouvelles, roster, dernier_podcast, marchandise, promotions. Default seed disables 'promotions' only. Fan users correctly get 403 on all admin endpoints and see 'Accès administrateur requis' block on /admin. Note: expo-image-picker does open in web preview but tests bypassed via direct multipart HTTP upload as recommended.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found for the tested features.
